extDesc.message: Cleans tracking out of links you copy and warns when a pasted crypto address isn't the one you copied. Works offline; sends nothing.

menuCopyPageClean.message: Copy clean link to this page

toastRemoved.message: Zcan · trackers removed from the copied link: $COUNT$

guardTitle.message: Check this address before you send

guardBody.message: The crypto address you just pasted isn’t the one you last copied in this browser. If you didn’t copy it from somewhere else, your clipboard may have been changed by malware.

guardLookalike.message: The pasted address starts and ends like the one you copied, but the middle is different. Clipboard-hijacking malware does exactly this. Don’t send.

popupCopyPage.message: Copy clean link to this page

popupNothing.message: Nothing to copy on this page

popupCleanOnCopyHint.message: Strips utm_, fbclid, gclid and other trackers

popupGuardHint.message: Warns if a pasted crypto address was swapped

popupToast.message: Show a note when a link is cleaned

popupPrivate.message: Everything runs in your browser. The extension makes no network requests.
